title.narrative: Digital Transformation Centre: Supporting Kenya¿s Digital Transition Towards a Sustainable and Human-Centred Digital Economy and Society

description.narrative: The project will aim at supporting Kenya¿s digital agenda and transformation as well as the EU¿s partnership with Africa on the transition to the digital age. It is part of and contributes to the Team Europe Initiative on Human-Centred Digitalisation and will strengthen the EU¿s engagement in the sector by assisting Kenya to tap into the EU¿s sizable experience with regards the digitalisation of SMEs, building a conducive innovation ecosystem, setting up open and secure e-government services and implementing sound data protection standards, both for the benefit of the country¿s development (human-centred approach) and EU interests.
